title: Termination of the classical inflation hierarchy on pair-source networks
summary: Machine-checked Lean 4 proofs of two theorems about the classical inflation hierarchy. The headline theorem, TriangleInflation.Graph.classification_NW, classifies the scenarios on which the hierarchy terminates: for a pair-source scenario with binary observations, some finite Navascués–Wolfe order characterizes compatibility iff every connected component is a double-star, and then order two suffices.
